selection_rule: One completed deterministic execution for each of the three predeclared T006 kinematic/ownership cases; no case is excluded.
limits_of_selection: Endpoint separation is between wrist-roll-link endpoints only and is not a collision clearance metric.
No collision/contact events or video exist because the execution backend has no physics or rendering, and the USD self-collision defect prevents a collision-valid functional arm run.
These selected runs do not close the collision part of T006 and do not promote a bilateral live-Quest trace.
